main.title: OpenMausBot
main.hostTooOld: This OpenMausBot plugin needs a newer POM (plugin host version 7). Update POM to use it.
access.title: Phone access
access.intro: Choose how your phone reaches OpenMausBot. Every phone still has to pair: open OpenMausBot's Settings, Phone & devices, and scan the QR with the OpenMausBot app. Saving restarts OpenMausBot.
access.way.local.hint: Only through POM, on this machine's screen.
access.way.tunnel.hint: A free public HTTPS address from OpenMausBot. Needs an OpenMausBot account; traffic passes through their servers.
access.way.tailscale.hint: Encrypted, only for devices on your tailnet. Tailscale must be installed and signed in on this machine and on the phone.
access.account.why: The tunnel needs this machine signed in to an OpenMausBot account. We email you an 8-digit code.
access.account.checkEmail: Check your email and type the code here.
access.account.signedIn: This machine is signed in to an OpenMausBot account.
access.tailscale.missing: Tailscale is not installed on this machine (in Docker, inside the container).
access.lan.label: Also allow phones on this network
access.lan.hint: Not encrypted. In Docker the QR carries the container's address, which phones cannot reach; use it when POM runs directly on the machine or with host networking.
access.saved: Saved. OpenMausBot is restarting with the new access.
